capability.description: Calls Open-Meteo forecast with required latitude and longitude and fixed current_weather=true. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Coordinate-based current weather retrieval; not climate forecasting, severe-weather warning, or geocoding.

constraint.io_signature: Input: latitude at CLI position 1 and longitude at position 2. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Open-Meteo result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no timezone, forecast_days, hourly, units, model, pagination, or geocoding input
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the response
no authentication, cache, retry, or weather-alert guarantee

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Open-Meteo current weather data, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: issue a severe-weather warning or climate projection

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Open-Meteo current weather data, URL, and HTTP status.
